description: Gotchas for the Miniflare/@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers integration test harness

entries.bad_pattern: Relying on D1/KV state written in one `it` (or a prior test) being visible in another `it` — e.g. signup in one test, assert duplicate-rejected in the next.
entries.good_pattern: Make every `it` self-contained (seed its own data). Seed shared baseline data in beforeAll (those writes ARE visible to every test); per-`it` writes are NOT.
entries.details: vitest-pool-workers runs with isolatedStorage (default true): each test gets its own copy of D1/KV, reset between tests. beforeAll/beforeEach writes form the baseline every test sees; writes made inside a test stay local to that test. Symptom: a 'duplicate'/'login after signup' assertion in a separate `it` sees an empty DB and fails (got 200/401 instead of 409/200). Fix: combine the create+assert into one `it`, or seed in beforeAll.

entries.bad_pattern: Expecting `vitest run --coverage` to work with the default v8 provider inside workerd.
entries.good_pattern: Use provider: 'istanbul' in vitest.config (install @vitest/coverage-istanbul pinned to the exact vitest version). v8 coverage doesn't work in the workers pool.
entries.details: Coverage inside workerd requires the istanbul provider; the v8 provider produces no/garbage data. Also @vitest/coverage-istanbul must match the vitest version EXACTLY (ERESOLVE peer conflict otherwise) — install @vitest/coverage-istanbul@<vitest-version>. The fast pure-logic suites use Node's built-in V8 coverage separately (scripts/coverage.sh); these are two distinct coverage systems.
